description.value:
An ally's attack grants you Energy Regeneration score +1 per stack, capped at 5. Your Ultimate consumes all stacks to grant you attack bonus +2 and party damage +2 until your next turn.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching harmony Path required.

source.custom: Honkai: Star Rail / Telys D&D conversion
